newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: European bishops' conference begins in Austria.
newsitem.headline: European bishops' conference begins in Austria.

text.p: Christian leaders from around Europe gathered on Monday in the southern Austrian town of Graz for the Second European Ecumenical Conference, whose chief theme was reconciliation.

Over 10,000 participants were expected to attend the week-long forum, including Patriarch Alexiy of the Russian Orthodox Church, the Archbishop of Canterbury George Carey, who heads the Anglican Church, and Karekin, spiritual leader of Armenian Christians.

A proposed meeting between Alexiy and Pope John Paul ahead of the conference was called off by the Russian Orthodox Church, which said the churches had failed to agree on important issues that had to be settled first
It would have been the first meeting of its kind since the Great Schism split Christendom in 1054.
The first bishops' conference in Europe was held in Basle in Switzerland in 1989.
